mutants.name: hook-regrows-local-default-root
mutants.why: a hook that re-adds a local def _default_root bypasses the shared module; s1's grep finds ^def _default_root and fails
mutants.replacement:
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from _common import _default_root, _log_path, hooklog, _validate_session_id
def _default_root():
    return __import__('pathlib').Path.home() / 'Developer' / 'eluvian-governance'

mutants.name: default-root-fallback-wrong-candidate
mutants.why: swapping candidate order makes the fallback (no-marker case) return GitHub instead of eluvian-governance; test_c_no_marker asserts eluvian-governance

mutants.name: hooklog-raises-on-unwritable
mutants.why: removing the except swallow means hooklog raises on an unwritable log path; s3 tests that hooklog never raises

mutants.name: emit-wrong-event-name
mutants.why: naming Stop instead of SessionStart produces wrong JSON; s4 asserts hookEventName == SessionStart

mutants.name: arm-hook-missing-sys-path-insert
mutants.why: without sys.path.insert the hook cannot find _common when loaded by path (spec_from_file_location); test_c_no_marker path-loads all four hooks and exec_module fails on ImportError

mutants.name: validate-session-id-widens-charset
mutants.why: admitting . and / in _VALID_SESSION_ID lets ../etc/passwd pass validation; test_invalid_charset_arms_bare sends that string and asserts only the bare sentinel exists
